_comment: Docs-facing extras applied by tools/sync_release_docs.py:enhance_spec(). FastAPI does not emit any of this; Mintlify reads all of it from the published spec. tag_descriptions and request_examples are maintained automatically by the spec extras sync workflow (tools/fix_spec_extras.py) - edit them here, not in the Python source. request_examples is keyed by "METHOD /path" rather than FastAPI's operationId: the operationId embeds the handler function name, so renaming a handler silently orphaned its example.

tag_descriptions.activity: Activity endpoints for inspecting pipeline runs, traced spans, tenant users, agents, and dataset exports.
tag_descriptions.add: Data ingestion endpoints for adding text, files, and structured data.
tag_descriptions.agent connections: Endpoints for registering, unregistering, and inspecting agent connections to the instance.
tag_descriptions.agent management: Endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, and deleting agents.
tag_descriptions.auth: Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, and token management.
tag_descriptions.checks: Diagnostic endpoint for verifying connectivity to a configured service.
tag_descriptions.cognify: Knowledge processing endpoints to transform raw data into knowledge graphs.
tag_descriptions.configuration: Endpoints for storing, retrieving, and listing a user's saved configurations.
tag_descriptions.datasets: Dataset management endpoints for listing, creating, and deleting datasets.
tag_descriptions.delete: Data deletion endpoints (deprecated — use datasets endpoints instead).
tag_descriptions.forget: Endpoint for removing data from the knowledge graph.
tag_descriptions.health: Liveness, readiness, and component health checks, plus the service root endpoint.
tag_descriptions.improve: Endpoint for enriching and improving an existing knowledge graph.
tag_descriptions.integrations: Endpoints for connecting, provisioning, and disconnecting OAuth providers and plugins.
tag_descriptions.llm: LLM-backed endpoints for inferring graph schemas and generating custom extraction prompts.
tag_descriptions.memify: Endpoint for running enrichment pipelines over existing graphs or supplied data.
tag_descriptions.ontologies: Endpoints for uploading, listing, and deleting ontology files used during cognify.
tag_descriptions.permissions: Permission management for multi-user access control.
tag_descriptions.recall: Endpoints for querying the knowledge graph and reviewing past recall history.
tag_descriptions.remember: Endpoints for ingesting data into the knowledge graph and storing session memory entries.
tag_descriptions.responses: Response generation endpoints using the knowledge graph.
tag_descriptions.schema: Endpoints for inspecting a dataset's derived schema and memory provenance graphs.
tag_descriptions.search: Search endpoints for querying the knowledge graph.
tag_descriptions.sessions: Endpoints for listing sessions and reporting usage, cost, and token statistics.
tag_descriptions.settings: Configuration endpoints for managing Cognee settings.
tag_descriptions.skills: Endpoints for ingesting, listing, retrieving, and deleting dataset skills and improvement proposals.
tag_descriptions.slack: Endpoints for listing workspace channels, setting channel allowlists, and linking Slack accounts.
tag_descriptions.sync: Endpoints for syncing local data to Cognee Cloud and checking sync status.
tag_descriptions.update: Endpoint for updating existing data in a dataset.
tag_descriptions.validate: Diagnostic endpoint for checking consistency between a dataset's graph and vector stores.

POST /api/v1/add.data: Cognee is a knowledge graph platform for AI applications.
